text.arabic_uthmani: لَّهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍۢ

words.gloss_range: fronted recipient/allocation lām in a nominal clause, assigning the first punishment to the carried-over group

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the delayed punishment noun assigned by the opening recipient frame

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) opens by putting the recipients first: the clause first fixes who the consequence is for, then lets {{ar:عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) arrive as the delayed thing assigned. The same recipient frame returns near the end under negation, so the ayah moves from a share allotted to them to protection denied to them.

topics.headline: fronted recipient assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the affected group before the punishment is named, so the first beat feels like an assigned share rather than a detached statement.
topics.reason: The opening prepositional predicate governs the pronoun and precedes the delayed punishment noun, creating a fronted allocation frame.

topics.headline: recipient frame returns at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same recipient frame later returns under negation, turning what is assigned to them into what is denied to them.
topics.reason: The same preposition-pronoun frame opens the ayah and reappears near the final no-protector clause, with the antecedent carried from the prior ayah.

words.gloss_range: bound third-person plural pronoun governed by lām, carrying the prior denier group into the ayah
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) is not an independent noun; it is bound inside the opening lām phrase and has to be resolved from the preceding discourse. Its repetition later keeps the same collective under both the assigned punishment and the denied protection.

topics.headline: bound pronoun imports prior referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader must carry the denier group forward from the previous discourse before the sentence names what happens to them.
topics.reason: The pronoun has no new in-ayah antecedent and is governed inside the opening lām phrase, so it routes reference back to the prior denier group.

topics.headline: same plural group across opening and closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the collective exposed at the opening remains the same collective exposed at the no-protector closure.
topics.reason: The repeated third-person plural pronoun binds the first and final beats to one discourse group.

words.gloss_range: indefinite assigned punishment in the worldly-life domain, opening a later definite afterlife-punishment contrast
words.root_gloss_range: punishment, adverse consequence, and a root-family contrast with sweetness or withheld pleasantness; locally selected as punishment, not a free sweetness image
words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) arrives after the fronted recipients as an indefinite punishment assigned within the first beat. Its root-family pressure can make the consequence feel like deprivation of sweetness, while the local clause keeps the actual sense as punishment. Because the same noun returns in the next beat, this first occurrence starts the escalation from worldly assignment to specified afterlife punishment and finally to no shield.

topics.headline: indefinite delayed punishment in the worldly beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first punishment as an open-ended assigned condition before the afterlife punishment is made definite and harsher.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative, indefinite, and delayed after the fronted recipient phrase, then bounded by the life-domain phrase.

topics.headline: punishment carries deprivation-of-sweetness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears punishment not as neutral suffering but as an adverse consequence felt as deprivation of what would be sweet or good.
topics.reason: Lexical evidence supports the root-family sweetness contrast, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as punishment rather than making sweetness itself the local referent.

topics.headline: first punishment starts an escalation arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first punishment noun as the opening term of a sequence that moves to afterlife punishment and then to no shield.
topics.reason: The same punishment noun recurs in Beat B with changed definiteness, and boundary evidence places this noun at the turn from diagnosis into sentence.

words.gloss_range: preposition of temporal-spatial containment, locating the first punishment inside worldly life
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the first punishment domain-bound: it is within or during the worldly life. That containment matters because the next beat does not repeat the preposition; it shifts to a construct phrase, making the afterlife punishment feel specified by its realm rather than merely located in it.

topics.headline: worldly punishment is containerized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first punishment is placed inside the worldly-life domain instead of being left realm-neutral.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the life noun and attaches it to the punishment noun as its temporal-spatial domain.

topics.headline: prepositional containment contrasts with construct possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a structural shift: worldly punishment is in a domain, while afterlife punishment is named as the punishment of that realm.
topics.reason: Beat A uses prepositional containment, whereas Beat B uses an iḍāfa relation with the afterlife term.

words.gloss_range: definite life-state governed by the containment preposition and narrowed by the near-world qualifier
words.root_gloss_range: life, living state, animation, and related moral-awareness pressure; locally the domain phrase for present worldly life

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the near/lower qualifier that narrows the life-domain

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayāti}}) is the governed life-domain in which the first punishment is placed. The root’s living and moral-awareness pressure makes that domain feel like active life, not a dead interval, while the following {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) narrows it to the recognized worldly-life phrase. The same field recalls the earlier worldly-life valuation in 13:26, now revalued as a domain of punishment.

topics.headline: life as definite governed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is already operative inside a recognized worldly-life phrase, not postponed outside life.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after the preposition and tightly qualified by the following near-world term, forming the known worldly-life domain.

topics.headline: life carries animate and moral-awareness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the punished domain as living, morally charged existence, while the phrase remains the worldly-life domain.
topics.reason: Root-family evidence supports animate life and moral-awareness associations, but local grammar selects the life-state as the domain of punishment.

topics.headline: life term enters the realm contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the life phrase as the first pole of a realm sequence that returns from 13:26 and then moves to the afterlife.
topics.reason: The current phrase stands in the same-surah worldly-life field and is paired structurally with the afterlife term in Beat B.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine comparative qualifier meaning the near/lower worldly realm, bound to life and opposed to the afterlife
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, lowness, proximity, and comparative inferiority; locally the near/lower qualifier in the worldly-life phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the afterlife term that completes the realm contrast
the life noun qualified by the near/lower realm word

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) locks the life-domain into the near and lower realm. Its comparative shape already leans toward a counterpart, so the coming {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) is prepared before it is stated. The paired long-vowel cadence with {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayāti}}) helps the phrase land as one domain before the next beat interrupts. The same realm pair recalls 13:26, but here the near life is not a site of rejoicing; it is the first domain of punishment.

topics.headline: near/lower qualifier locks onto life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first realm is not life in general but the near or lower life, already implying a counterpart.
topics.reason: The definite feminine comparative form agrees with the life noun and supplies nearness/lowness as the domain qualifier.

topics.headline: near realm presupposes the afterlife counterpart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the next realm already prepared by the comparative shape of the near-world word before the afterlife is named.
topics.reason: The word is a strong corpus and local pair with the afterlife term, and the ayah repeats the same realm axis found in 13:26.

topics.headline: Beat A closes on the near realm before escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first beat close as a cohesive worldly-life phrase before the emphatic afterlife beat interrupts.
topics.reason: The word closes Beat A and is acoustically bound to the life noun, giving the phrase a compact landing before the next conjunction.

words.gloss_range: conjunction that coordinates the second nominal clause while preparing emphatic escalation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the fused conjunction, emphatic lām, and repeated punishment noun at the second beat onset

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than add another statement; it carries Beat A forward into a stronger Beat B because it immediately meets the emphatic lām. The tight {{ar:وَلَعَذَابُ}} ({{tr:wa-la-ʿadhābu}}) onset pushes the sound directly into the repeated punishment noun, so the escalation is heard before it is unpacked. The repeated beat-opening pattern gives the ayah a paced movement: assignment, intensified comparison, then final denial.

topics.headline: conjunction introduces emphatic escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Beat B both continues the sentence and raises its force through the following emphatic lām.
topics.reason: The conjunction begins the second nominal assertion and immediately joins with the emphatic particle before the repeated punishment noun.

topics.headline: first repeated beat-opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second beat as the first marked step in a paced three-beat escalation.
topics.reason: The conjunction at word 7 and the later conjunction at word 12 create parallel beat openings.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām prefixed to the afterlife-punishment noun, asserting the comparison with certainty
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) upgrades the second punishment clause at the moment the repeated punishment noun returns. The surface resembles the opening lām, but its job has changed from assigning to asserting, so the grammar itself escalates from bare declaration to emphatic certainty.

topics.headline: emphatic lām raises certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the afterlife-punishment comparison is grammatically insisted on, not merely reported.
topics.reason: The lām is emphatic and prefixed directly to the repeated punishment noun, strengthening the nominal assertion.

topics.headline: same lām surface changes function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah reuse the same small surface form for different jobs: allocation at the opening, assertion in the escalation.
topics.reason: Word 1 is prepositional lām in a possession frame, while word 8 is an emphatic lām attached to the afterlife-punishment subject.

words.gloss_range: construct-state punishment specified as the afterlife punishment and compared as harsher
words.root_gloss_range: punishment and adverse consequence as a recurring noun-state; locally specified by the afterlife construct phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the genitive afterlife term specifying the construct punishment

words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابُ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābu}}) repeats the punishment noun but changes its grammar: no tanwīn, construct state, and specification by {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}). That makes the second punishment defined by the final realm. The noun-state and deprivation pressure continue from the first occurrence, but the local payoff is the escalation from an indefinite worldly punishment to the specified afterlife punishment that the next word ranks as harsher.

topics.headline: construct-bound afterlife punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second punishment as the specified punishment of the afterlife, not just another indefinite hardship.
topics.reason: The noun is a construct head without tanwīn and is specified by the following afterlife genitive.

topics.headline: punishment state continues across realms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the punishment concept as a standing state carried into the final realm, with root pressure of adverse deprivation still present.
topics.reason: The repeated abstract noun keeps punishment as a state; lexical pressure survives, while local grammar selects the specified punishment sense.

topics.headline: repetition builds the middle escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one punishment root across two realms before the closing no-protector clause answers both.
topics.reason: The local echo shifts from indefinite first occurrence to construct definite second occurrence, producing an escalation arc.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive afterlife term, the final coming-after realm that specifies the second punishment
words.root_gloss_range: behindness, posteriority, delay, finality, and otherness; locally the known afterlife realm in construct with punishment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the near/lower realm term contrasted with the afterlife

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) completes the construct phrase by naming the punishment’s final realm. Its active-participle background keeps the sense of the one coming after alive, so the movement from {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) to the afterlife is not just a place change but a sequence from near/lower life to final consequence. The same realm axis recalls 13:26 and is now made severe by the following comparison.

topics.headline: afterlife specifies the punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the afterlife term as the genitive that defines which punishment is being compared.
topics.reason: The word is genitive as the muḍāf ilayh of the punishment noun and completes the construct phrase.

topics.headline: active participle keeps coming-after sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the realm as the one coming after the near life, so the ayah’s sequence is temporal and evaluative at once.
topics.reason: The active-participle form functions as a noun while preserving the root sense of posteriority and finality.

topics.headline: afterlife completes the realm axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the afterlife as the second pole of the same realm contrast already heard in 13:26, now intensified by punishment.
topics.reason: The word completes the strong worldly-life and afterlife pair and stands immediately before the comparative predicate.

words.gloss_range: comparative predicate meaning harsher or more difficult, with rupture-hardship pressure from the root
words.root_gloss_range: splitting, fissure, schism, and hardship; locally narrowed to comparative severity of the afterlife punishment
words.prose: {{ar:أَشَقُّ}} ({{tr:ashaqqu}}) is the predicate that ranks the afterlife punishment above the worldly one, even without an explicit compared-to phrase. The root’s splitting and fissure field makes that comparison feel like rupture-hardship rather than generic intensity, while grammar keeps the local sense as harsher. Its rare comparative form and doubled final consonant make the middle beat land with compressed force, creating the need for refuge that the next beat immediately denies.

topics.headline: comparative predicate ranks the punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the afterlife punishment is not merely additional; it is ranked above the worldly punishment in hardship.
topics.reason: The comparative adjective is the predicate of the afterlife-punishment clause, and its comparison target is supplied by the prior beat.

topics.headline: hardship is felt through splitting imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the comparison as cleaving or rupture-hardship rather than generic intensity, while the local predicate still means harsher.
topics.reason: Root evidence links splitting, fissure, and hardship; local grammar narrows that field to the comparative predicate of severity.

topics.headline: unique comparative and compressed sound mark the middle landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the middle beat land on a marked, compressed comparative form before the no-protector clause begins.
topics.reason: Occurrence and sound rows make the comparative form and geminated closure salient without changing the local sense.

topics.headline: severity creates need that final clause denies
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the harsher-punishment predicate as the pressure point that makes the following denial of a protector necessary.
topics.reason: The comparative closes Beat B and immediately yields to the final negated nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: conjunction introducing the final negated nominal clause as connected closure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the negative particle that begins the final denial
the compressed conjunction-plus-negation onset of the final beat

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the final clause attached to the harsher-punishment comparison, but it immediately turns into negation with {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}). The compressed {{ar:وَمَا}} ({{tr:wa-mā}}) onset mirrors the earlier marked beat opening while changing polarity. The ayah therefore does not add a third punishment term; it adds the closing loss of any shield.

topics.headline: conjunction opens terminal negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final beat is connected to the escalation but changes polarity into denial.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the final nominal clause and immediately joins the negative particle.

topics.headline: second marked beat-opener closes the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah’s sequence tighten through repeated beat openings until the third-person declarative sentence closes in negation.
topics.reason: The word mirrors the earlier conjunction while maintaining the declarative register into the closing clause.

words.gloss_range: negative particle negating the whole final nominal clause and enabling exhaustive no-protector force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later emphatic min that universalizes the no-protector denial

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) turns the recipient frame from possession into absence. After the ayah has said what is for them, this particle scopes over the whole final clause and, with the later emphatic {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), denies any protector at all. Hijazi and Tamimi grammar accounts leave that denial stable, while the repeated m/n sounds tighten the closure.

topics.headline: negative particle scopes over no-protector clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final beat denies the entire possession-and-protection proposition, not just a single noun.
topics.reason: The particle negates the nominal clause and combines with the later emphatic min to deny any protector.

topics.headline: negation reverses the earlier having-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah pivot from what exists for them to what cannot exist for them.
topics.reason: The same recipient frame that assigned punishment is placed under negation in the final clause.

topics.headline: negative grammar and nasal pattern reinforce totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final negation knit together by repeated nasal particles while the grammatical variants leave the denial unchanged.
topics.reason: The Hijazi/Tamimi analysis does not alter the local negative force, and the sound rows support the no-protector architecture.

words.gloss_range: prepositional lām in the negated possession frame, marking the group for whom no protector exists

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the negative particle governing the final possession frame

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) reprises the opening recipient frame, but now under {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}). The result is a sharp reversal: the same form that helped assign punishment now frames the absence of a protector. That return bookends the ayah’s movement from what is allotted to them to what is unavailable for them.

topics.headline: same recipient frame under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same for-them frame now carrying absence instead of possession.
topics.reason: The lām governs the pronoun in the fronted predicate phrase of the negated nominal clause.

topics.headline: opening frame returns near closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole ayah framed by the same recipient marker: punishment assigned at the start, protection denied at the end.
topics.reason: The opening preposition-pronoun frame recurs in the final clause with opposite polarity.

words.gloss_range: bound third-person plural pronoun governed by the final lām, co-referential with the opening group
words.prose: {{ar:هُم}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the final denial attached to the same collective as the opening assignment. Because the pronoun stays bound rather than becoming a fresh noun phrase, the closing clause snaps back to the original target while denying them any protector.

topics.headline: same plural referent in the final denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final absence of protection applies to the same collective carried from the prior ayah and named at the opening.
topics.reason: The pronoun is co-referential with the opening pronoun and remains governed by the repeated lām frame.

topics.headline: bound form snaps closure back to opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final pronoun as a compact return to the opening surface rather than a newly named group.
topics.reason: The suffix pronoun repeats the bound shape from the opening recipient frame.

words.gloss_range: source/adversative min governing the divine name in the no-protector construction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the second min that exhaustively denies the protector category

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) gives the final exposure its direction: no protector from God. It is distinct from the later {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}); this first particle names the source or opposing force, while the second will make the denied protector category exhaustive.

topics.headline: first min names divine source/opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied protection is specifically protection from God, not generic lack of help.
topics.reason: This preposition governs the divine name and marks the source or opposing force from whom protection would be needed.

topics.headline: first min prepares emphatic second min
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish the two identical particles: one points to the source, the other universalizes the denied protector category.
topics.reason: Word 16 governs the divine name, while word 18 governs the protector noun under negation; together they form the dense final no-agent formula.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the genitive source from whom no protector can shield them
words.root_gloss_range: worship, deity, awe, and bewilderment in the root field; locally the unique proper divine name as source of inescapable consequence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the source-marking min before the divine name
the emphatic min after the divine name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is governed by the source preposition, so the final clause is not general vulnerability but no protection from God. The proper-name form removes generic deity ambiguity, while the wider root field can leave a background sense of overwhelming divinity. The punishment and protection fields converge here: the one normally associated with protection is now the source from whom no shield exists. The name is audibly bracketed by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) and {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), and the same no-protector-from-God refrain returns in 13:37.

topics.headline: proper divine name fixes the source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final exposure is tied to the proper divine name, not to a replaceable or generic source.
topics.reason: The word is the proper divine name in genitive after the source preposition, making the source unique and non-substitutable.

topics.headline: worship and bewilderment pressure remains backgrounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the overwhelming divine reality behind the source phrase, while local grammar keeps the surface as the proper name.
topics.reason: Root-field and derivational rows add worship and bewilderment pressure, but the local surface is the proper divine name governed by the preposition.

topics.headline: divine name completes punishment and protection fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divine name as the point where repeated punishment and denied protection converge.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows tie the divine name to the punishment and protection fields, locally inverted as no protection from God.

topics.headline: same-surah no-protector refrain and bracketing sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the divine name bracketed by the two min particles and sees the same no-protector-from-God refrain recur in 13:37.
topics.reason: The evidence gives the same-surah refrain in 13:37 and a sound pattern around the divine name in the final clause.

words.gloss_range: emphatic min under negation, governing the indefinite protector and making the denial exhaustive

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the negation under which this min universalizes absence
the first min, marking God as source
the final protector noun governed by emphatic min

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) is syntactically small but semantically decisive: under {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) it turns the clause into not a single protector. Its surface repeats word 16, but its function differs; the first {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) points to God as source, and this one closes the set of possible shields. It delays and amplifies the final noun so that {{ar:وَاقٍ}} ({{tr:wāqin}}) arrives already framed as the universally denied category.

topics.headline: second min universalizes the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause denies not just a known protector but any protector at all.
topics.reason: This min functions under negation as the emphatic particle governing the indefinite protector noun.

topics.headline: same surface splits source and exhaustive absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the first min as source-marking and the second as exhaustive negation, even though the surface repeats.
topics.reason: The first min governs the divine name, while this second min governs the protector noun and universalizes the category.

topics.headline: particle sets up final landing on protector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final noun delayed and amplified before the ayah lands on the denied protector.
topics.reason: The second min immediately precedes the final active participle and participates in the repeated no-agent formula.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active participle under emphatic negation: not any protector or shielding agent
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, covering, preserving, barrier-making, external protection, and self-guarding forms; locally the denied external protector-agent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the qiraat variant that preserves the active-protector sense while changing final sound weight
the same-root self-guarding class referenced by the forward bridge to 13:35

words.prose: {{ar:وَاقٍ}} ({{tr:wāqin}}) is the final landing: an indefinite active participle under emphatic negation, so not even one protector-agent remains. The root’s guarding and covering field makes the denied figure feel like a missing barrier-maker, while the local form is external protection rather than the root’s self-guarding forms. The qiraat variant {{ar:وَاقِي}} ({{tr:wāqī}}) preserves that active-protector sense while changing the final syllable weight. Ending here resolves the ayah’s arc from assigned punishment to harsher afterlife punishment to unshielded exposure; the no-protector-from-God refrain returns in 13:37, and the same root turns forward to {{ar:ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muttaqūna}}) in 13:35.

topics.headline: indefinite active participle denies any protector-agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies an agent who could protect, not only an abstract idea of safety.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite active participle governed by emphatic min under negation, so the whole protector category is denied.

topics.headline: guarding root gives barrier image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the denied protector as a missing barrier-maker between the group and the divine-source consequence.
topics.reason: Root evidence supports protection as covering or barrier-making, while local grammar selects the active protector-agent.

topics.headline: external shield contrasts with self-guarding root family
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing denial of an outside shield point forward to the same root’s ethical self-guarding class in 13:35.
topics.reason: The root family includes self-guarding forms, but local grammar denies an external active participle; the next ayah gives the same root as the class of the self-guarding.

topics.headline: variant preserves agency while changing closure weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the final word as both semantic endpoint and recitational endpoint, with the variant affecting sound but not meaning.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows preserve the active participle sense while noting final yāʾ retention or loss in recitation.

topics.headline: closing no-shield noun resolves the ayah arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word answer both punishment clauses: assigned consequence and harsher consequence end in unshielded exposure.
topics.reason: The final noun closes the three-beat arc and links to the no-guide or no-protector refrain, including the recurrence in 13:37.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.scope_en: Covers worship, devotion, and a being or thing treated as an object of worship, including deity, idols, and the sun when named for being worshipped.

variants.scope_en: Covers worship, devotion, and a being or thing treated as an object of worship, including deity, idols, and the sun when named for being worshipped.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Repeated عذاب at words 2 and 6, الدنيا at 5, الآخرة at 7, comparative أشق at 8, and negated واق at 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated punishment is distributed across a near/first horizon and a later horizon. The comparative increases the burden, while the closing negation removes any barrier capable of intercepting that escalation.

activation_trace.role: Painful punishment supplies the literal event repeated across both horizons.
The nearer or first world locates the first punishment in the presently close horizon.
Latter-after-first supplies the second temporal horizon.
A burden that strains the self gives the comparative its escalatory force.
A barrier that turns harm away is explicitly negated, closing off interruption.

changed_reading.before: A list of punishment now, worse punishment later, and no helper.
changed_reading.after: A paired temporal escalation from the near life to the latter stage, sealed by the failure of every intercepting shield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of عذاب, life at word 4, and the absence of a واق at word 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches suppressed by the ordinary penal sense overlay pain with deprivation: sweetness can be unavailable, eating and drinking can cease, life-benefit can contract, and an uncovered body can lack a protective layer.

activation_trace.role: Palatable water and food supply the nourishing good whose loss can texture punishment.
Abstention from food and drink turns punishment toward bodily deprivation.
Being uncovered beneath the sky supplies exposure as a material condition of punishment.
Life as benefit identifies what deprivation diminishes rather than merely where pain occurs.
The missing protective barrier leaves deprivation and exposure uninterrupted.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is only externally inflicted pain during life and afterlife.
changed_reading.after: Alongside pain, punishment may be experienced as loss of nourishment and life-benefit under conditions of radical exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparative أشق at word 8 and the terminal absence of a واق.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant split-root branches let أشق retain a texture of opening, division, and social rupture. The later punishment can therefore be more rending, not merely larger on a generic severity scale.

activation_trace.role: Cracking and opening supply material rending inside the comparative.
A group split by hostility extends rending into the social and relational domain.
The lack of a barrier means the rupture has no insulating layer.

changed_reading.before: أشق means only more difficult or severe.
changed_reading.after: أشق can also describe punishment as more deeply rending across bodily and relational integrity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier guarding is real but bounded: guards can preserve, yet an adverse divine intent has no repeller. The focus's missing واق is therefore not a claim that protective means never exist; it marks the point where subordinate means cannot reverse the source of judgment.

activation_trace.role: The negated harm-barrier is the focus endpoint whose scope is being clarified.
Active guarding shows that ordinary preservation can operate before the no-protection limit is reached.
Turning away and preventing harm names precisely the operation declared unavailable against the intended evil.

structural_cues: 13:11 places guards before and behind, then says an intended evil has no repeller and no wali.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: guarding, self-change, and no repeller occur in one sequence. Inference: available guards are subordinate means, so adverse divine intent disables rather than merely outnumbers them. Alternative: the sequence may juxtapose distinct forms of protection without defining their hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: No واق means protection is simply absent.
changed_reading.after: Protection exists as a contingent delegated process, but no such process can turn divine judgment back once its limit is reached.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person stretching both hands toward water that never reaches the mouth activates the focus's sweetness, abstention, and nearness branches. Worldly punishment can take the form of nourishment being close and visibly available but structurally unable to arrive.

activation_trace.role: Sweet water and palatable intake supply the desired nourishment in the changed reading.
Not eating or drinking supplies the bodily result of failed uptake.
Nearness makes the deprivation sharper because the desired good is not spatially remote.
The extended hand supplies active reaching rather than passive lack.
The literal palms make the failed transfer bodily and immediate.
Actual water supplies the near sweetness that remains unusable.
Failure to reach the endpoint converts proximity into deprivation.

structural_cues: 13:14 stages hand, water, mouth, and two reach-verbs in a failed transfer sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: water is near, hands extend, and arrival fails. Inference: this scene materializes a mode of عذاب in the near life as access without uptake. Alternative: it may illustrate failed invocation only, with no intended semantic pressure on عذاب.

changed_reading.before: Worldly punishment is an adverse event imposed on someone.
changed_reading.after: One live form of worldly punishment is thirst-in-proximity: the good is near and grasped toward, yet never becomes sustaining intake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts using good to repel evil with cutting what should remain joined. That enacted severance activates the focus's cracking and schism branches, making the harsher punishment a realized intensification of the rupture already practiced.

activation_trace.role: Material cracking gives the later punishment the texture of realized severance.
Schism and hostile division connect bodily rending to broken relations.
Doing good supplies the reparative material used in the context's explicit repelling construction.
Severing connection supplies the human action whose form returns as intensified rupture.
Sustained connection identifies the integrity that the cutting action destroys.

structural_cues: 13:22 root د ر ء at word 13 explicitly makes good repel evil; it has no branch inventory and is used only as a structural cue.
13:25 grammatically opposes cutting at word 8 to what was commanded to be joined at word 14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repair/repelling and severing are opposed, while أشق carries rupture branches. Inference: the later rending corresponds to and intensifies the agent's earlier cuts. Alternative: أشق may remain a generic severity comparison with no mimetic relation.

changed_reading.before: The afterlife punishment is quantitatively harder.
changed_reading.after: It may be qualitatively more rending, as practiced severance returns in intensified bodily and relational form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same worldly life is enjoyed and rejoiced in shortly before the focus locates punishment within it. The sweetness and penal branches can therefore coexist: present punishment need not always feel bitter, but may be concealed within attractive, temporary benefit whose limits emerge only against the later horizon.

activation_trace.role: Sweetness permits an attractive surface to coexist with the ordinary punishment sense.
Painful penalty keeps the model anchored as punishment rather than turning it into a pleasure theme.
Exultant delight supplies the subjectively attractive surface of worldly life.
Enjoyed utility supplies real but bounded benefit relative to the later life.

structural_cues: 13:26 repeats الحياة الدنيا and الآخرة, reporting joy in the former and calling it mere enjoyment relative to the latter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: joy, useful enjoyment, and the same two horizons are supplied. Inference: their co-presence allows punishment to operate through an attractive but narrowing condition. Alternative: worldly pleasure and worldly punishment may simply be separate experiences that alternate.

changed_reading.before: Punishment in worldly life must be consciously painful whenever it occurs.
changed_reading.after: Worldly punishment may coexist with felt pleasure, with its punitive force lying in attractive confinement to a temporary horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recurring strikes near dwellings continue until a promise, while the next verse gives a sequence of respite, seizure, and punishment. The focus's two horizons become phases of one process: intermittent present impacts, extended delay, decisive taking, then the harsher latter stage.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the open interval before final intensification.
Punishment anchors both intermittent present effects and later closure.
A blow of one thing against another supplies punctuated worldly impacts near the dwelling.
Extended time and respite create the interval that prevents delay from meaning cancellation.
Taking to account supplies the transition from respite to decisive seizure.
Punishment following an offense supplies the consequential order of the phases.

structural_cues: 13:31 sequences recurring strikes near homes until the promise; 13:32 sequences respite, then seizure, then punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: impacts, deadline, respite, seizure, and punishment are sequentially supplied. Inference: these are stages that unpack the two punishments in the focus. Alternative: the earlier episodes may be examples rather than a fixed process model.

changed_reading.before: Worldly and afterlife punishments are two static locations.
changed_reading.after: They are stages in a temporal mechanism: warning impacts and respite do not cancel punishment but carry it toward seizure and harsher closure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus balances what they have, punishment, against what they do not have, a shield. God's standing care over every soul by what it acquires makes that grammar consequential: punishment is the possession that accrues, while an independent protector cannot be acquired against God.

activation_trace.role: Penalty is the adverse possession assigned by the opening لهم.
The absent harm-barrier is the counter-possession denied by the closing وما لهم.
Standing care and oversight keep every soul continuously within the accounting relation.
Acquiring gain supplies the ironic mechanism by which an adverse outcome becomes what one has.
The repeated acquisition of every soul confirms that the possession logic persists through the announced outcome.

structural_cues: The focus opens لهم عذاب and closes وما لهم, while 13:33 and 13:42 frame every soul by what it acquires.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: possession grammar, standing oversight, acquisition, and outcome are supplied. Inference: acquisition accrues into the punishment one has and cannot purchase a counter-shield. Alternative: the acquisition verses may establish knowledge only, not a possession mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is a detached sentence imposed from outside.
changed_reading.after: Punishment is also an accrued adverse possession, precisely balanced by the impossibility of possessing an autonomous shield against its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following garden gathers the inverse material system: practiced protection, a protective enclosure, perpetual edible provision, and shade. This sharply activates the focus's deprivation and exposure branches without replacing its ordinary penal sense.

activation_trace.role: Sweet water and food name the nourishing quality restored on the garden side of the contrast.
Cessation of eating and drinking supplies deprivation as the garden's inverse.
Uncovered exposure is reversed by enclosure and shade.
The missing barrier in the focus defines the protective lack reversed next.
Making oneself protective names the garden's recipients and turns protection into a practiced posture.
A protective shield supplies the enclosing counterpart to the absent واق.
Edible provision supplies the enduring intake opposed to deprivation.
Shade as covering reverses the focus's image of uncovered exposure.

structural_cues: 13:35 immediately follows the focus and contrasts running rivers, perpetual food, shade, and the outcome of the protected with fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: immediate contrast, shared و ق ي, enclosure, food, and shade are supplied. Inference: the garden is the material inverse that reveals deprivation and exposure inside the focus's punishment. Alternative: these may remain outcome contrasts without coloring عذاب's branch images.

changed_reading.before: No protector is an isolated legal denial after two punishments.
changed_reading.after: The denial is one side of a full material inversion: no shield, sustaining intake, or cover here versus practiced protection, enclosed abundance, and lasting shade next.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim no-wali/no-waq construction in 13:37 is conditional on following inclinations after knowledge has arrived. This recasts the focus's unshielded group as a trajectory produced by substituted allegiance, not an immutable class label.

activation_trace.role: The focus's denied harm-barrier is the construction whose mechanism is exposed by the later conditional.
Preventive restraint for reform supplies the ordered track from which the conditional departure occurs.
Allegiant following supplies the sustained directional choice that changes protection status.
Inclination of the self supplies what replaces the received judgment as guide.
Supportive alliance is denied alongside physical or causal shielding.
The repeated denied barrier makes the conditional directly resonate with the focus rather than merely echo its topic.

structural_cues: 13:37 repeats ما لك من الله من ... ولا واق and places it as the result clause of following desires after knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: received judgment, following, inclination, and the repeated protection denial form a conditional. Inference: this conditional supplies a path into the state announced at 13:34. Alternative: it may admonish the addressee analogically without explaining the earlier plural group.

changed_reading.before: The people in 13:34 simply belong to a permanently unprotected category.
changed_reading.after: Their unshielded state is conditionally reproducible: replacing known judgment with sustained allegiance to inclination leads into it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image of land repeatedly diminished from its edges offers a spatial mode for punishment in the near life: progressive peripheral loss before the harsher final rupture. The unrevisable judgment parallels the focus's missing shield.

activation_trace.role: Punishment keeps the edge-loss model tied to the focus rather than free-standing geography.
Nearness locates gradual erosion in the present horizon.
Cracking supplies the possible later intensification of incremental loss into rupture.
Loss of part of a thing supplies gradual subtraction rather than a single blow.
The edge or terminus locates where worldly diminution begins and advances.
Judgment between parties gives the erosion a juridical frame rather than a neutral material one.
Review and reconsideration name the operation explicitly denied to the judgment.

structural_cues: 13:41 uses ongoing arrival and diminution verbs, then states that God's judgment has no mu'aqqib.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: edge-loss and non-reviewable judgment are supplied. Inference: progressive subtraction is one concrete mode of worldly punishment that can culminate in the focus's harsher rupture. Alternative: the image may be a collective sign adjacent to, but not explanatory of, 13:34.

changed_reading.before: Worldly punishment arrives only as a discrete catastrophic event.
changed_reading.after: It may also operate as slow edge-erosion, a repeated loss of margins that precedes more complete later rending.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant non-dominant ش ق ق to ن ش ق mapping; valid as an image because it remains anchored at أشق and converges with the denied barrier at واق. Render only as an exploratory snare metaphor, never as a lexical replacement for أشق.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أشق at word 8 under the packet's non-dominant mapped root, reinforced by واق at word 14.

activation_trace.role: A creature caught in a tether from which it scarcely escapes supplies inescapable entrapment inside the comparative.
The denied protective barrier prevents the snare image from acquiring an exit or insulating layer.

changed_reading.before: The later punishment is merely more strenuous.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, it is more inescapably ensnaring: the sufferer is caught in a tightening relation with no protective exit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because a dangling strap or tip is materially distant from the ordinary punishment noun; valid as a branch image anchored in repeated عذاب, possessive لهم, and the context's recurring outcome/trace language. Render as an exploratory attachment metaphor, not an etymology or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated عذاب belongs to them through لهم, and the same sentence carries it across near and latter horizons.

activation_trace.role: A dangling tip, strap, or attachment supplies punishment as something tethered to and trailing its bearer.
A remaining trace or aftermath supplies the contextual image of consequence continuing behind the act.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an external episode that arrives and ends.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, punishment is an attached trailing consequence carried from the near horizon into the latter one.

strongest_changes: The garden immediately after the focus turns deprivation and exposure into a coherent inverse: no shield versus taqwa, enclosure, food, and shade.
13:37 makes loss of wali and waq conditional on following inclination after knowledge, recasting 13:34 as a trajectory rather than a fixed label.
13:31-33 turn the two punishments into respite, strike, seizure, and accrued possession rather than a bare two-item list.
Cutting commanded connections activates أشق as more rending, while the water scene activates worldly punishment as nearness without uptake.
summary.what_was_special: The ordinary penal reading remained strong, but suppressed material branches and a split-root mapping sustained coexisting readings of unreachable nourishment, attractive confinement, rupture, uncovered deprivation, gradual erosion, snare, and attached consequence.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the sweetness and deprivation branches of عذاب should color its semantics or remain counterimages activated only by 13:14 and 13:35.
Whether أشق supports actual rupture language or only generic difficulty.
Whether edge erosion in 13:41 is a mode of worldly punishment or an adjacent collective sign.
The non-dominant ن ش ق mapping is packet-valid but form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ش ق ق/B003` is a burden straining the self. The comparative places present and later punishment on one scale. I infer increasing load beyond capacity; punishment reads as unmanageable strain as well as pain.
2. `و ق ي/B001` is a protective barrier. Its negation follows intensified burden, while 13:22 showed good warding off evil. I infer that protection had to be built earlier and cannot be improvised after consequence arrives.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:37's repeated absence of protector confirmed that following desire dismantles the same barrier denied here.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Later punishment is a more straining deprivation with no intervening barrier.** `ع ذ ب / B005` is torment and punishment, while dormant `ع ذ ب / B003` is withholding and weaning away; `ش ق ق / B003` is a burden that strains the self, and `و ق ي / B001` is warding harm off with a protective barrier. The comparative moves from punishment in near life to a more straining later form, then removes any barrier from God. Nearby 13:31-32 supply partial strikes and delayed taking, while 13:35 immediately contrasts uninterrupted rivers, food, and shade with fire. I assign withholding the role of deprivation from sustaining goods and greater strain the role of its intensified later effect. The packet supplies the punishment contrast and the next ayah's provision contrast; I infer exclusion from sustaining flow -> increasing strain. The ayah therefore activates punishment as loss of protection and nourishment, not only added pain.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:35's rivers, continuous food, and shade supplied the strongest later activation of `ع ذ ب / B003` as withholding: punishment is the deprived inverse of an uninterrupted sustaining ecology. 13:37's repeated absence of `واق` confirmed the protection contrast.

baseline.text: Onlar için dünya hayatında bir azap vardır; ahiret azabı ise daha çetindir. Onları Allah'tan koruyacak kimse yoktur.

findings.text: Ahiret azabının daha çetin olması, kişinin taşıma gücünü giderek aşan ve benliği zorlayan daha ağır bir yük boyutu taşır.
Azap, yalnız eklenen acı değil, besleyen akıştan ve koruyucu gölgeden yoksun bırakılmanın giderek artan sıkıntısı olarak da okunabilir.
Koruyucu engel, sonuç geldikten sonra doğaçlama kurulamaz; daha önceki gidişat içinde oluşturulmuş olmalıdır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 - Deferred Seizure and Punitive Arrival
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Opposition is granted temporal room before seizure converts delay into punishment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Respite is a stretched interval whose endpoint is juridical capture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Seizure After Offense
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The offender is called to account, captured, and subjected to a descending affliction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: accountability for an offense (`quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`); capture and imprisonment (`quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`); punishment following offense (`quranic:root_001033:B007/m01`); painful chastisement (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); affliction descending upon a group (`quranic:root_001492:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:32 `أَخَذْتُهُم` (ء خ ذ) and `عِقَاب` (ع ق ب); 13:34 `عَذَاب` (ع ذ ب); 13:36-37 `أُنْزِلَ`/`أَنْزَلْنَاه` (ن ز ل).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Accountability, capture, punishment, and descending affliction form the endpoint of delay. The sequence converts an apparently open interval into a closed penal process.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, suyun tatlı, hoş ve tuzlu olmayan niteliğini merkeze alırken kolay tüketilen başka yiyecek ve içecekleri de kapsar. Tatlı su arama, suyu tatlı bulma ve iki belirli sıvıyı birlikte adlandırma kullanımları bu niteliğe bağlı yan kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek tat ve tüketim hoşluğudur; cezalandırma, yeme içmeden kesilme ve sudaki yabancı madde bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hem yalın nitelik bildiren biçimleri hem de tatlı su edinme, arama veya öyle sayma yapılarıyla sınırlı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Su başta olmak üzere bir yiyecek veya içeceğin tatlı, hoş ve kolay tüketilir olması; su için ayrıca tuzlu olmama niteliğini taşır. Bu niteliğe bağlı yapılar tatlı su edinmeyi, aramayı ya da bir şeyi tatlı saymayı anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Bir yiyecek veya içeceğin damakta hoş, tatlı ve kolay tüketilir olmasıdır.
Su söz konusu olduğunda hoş içimin yanında tuzlu olmama niteliği belirgindir.
Belirli yapılarda tatlı su edinme veya arama ve bir şeyi tatlı sayma anlatılır.
Bir ikili adlandırma tükürük ile şarabı birlikte bu hoşluk niteliği altında anar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği tatlı, hoş ve kolay tüketilen su, yiyecek veya içecektir; su edinme, arama ve tatlı sayma kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_gloss.text: tatlı ve kolay tüketilen yiyecek ya da içecek
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yiyecek ve içeceklerdeki ortak tat ve tüketim hoşluğu çekirdeğini, suyun tuzlu olmaması dahil, birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun tatlılığını ve hoş içimini eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Başka yiyecek ve içeceklere uzanan genel kapsamı dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tatlı içme suyu bulma veya bir yerden böyle su sağlama yapılarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tatlı suyu amaç edinme ve onu sağlama işlemini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade hayvan ya da insanın yemeden ve içmeden durduğu bir hali açıkça bildirir. Şiddetli susuzluk sık bir neden olsa da tüm tanıklarda zorunlu değildir; bu yüzden hal, açlık duygusuna veya dinî oruca indirgenmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal başkasını engellemekten değil, kişinin veya hayvanın fiilen yemeyip içmemesinden söz eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, hal bildiren biçimleri ve hayvanın, insanın ya da gecenin özne olduğu belirli yapıları ayırarak birlikte kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın veya hayvanın, çoğu kez şiddetli susuzluk yüzünden, hiçbir şey yemeden ve içmeden durmasıdır. Bu hal bir gece boyunca sürme veya yemek karşısında belirsiz bir ara durumda kalma biçiminde de anlatılır.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvan fiilen yiyecek ve içecek tüketmeden durur.
Hayvanda yememenin nedeni özellikle şiddetli susuzluk olabilir.
Hal, geceyi hiçbir şey yemeden ve içmeden geçirmek biçiminde anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, insan veya hayvanın yemeyip içmediği hali ortaklaştırır; şiddetli susuzluk bunun belirgin fakat her kullanım için zorunlu olmayan nedenidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın tüketmeme halini, nedeni ve süresi ayrıca belirtilebilen genel bir karşılıkla verir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem yememeyi hem içmemeyi ve bunun süren bir hal oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Şiddetli susuzluk yüzünden yemeyen hayvanın anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Susuzluğun yol açtığı yememe durumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: İçmeme bileşenini ve neden belirtilmeyen kullanımları açıkça söylemez.

error_profile.preserves: Yememeyi, içmemeyi ve gece boyunca sürmeyi birlikte korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam belirli edatlı ve ettirgen yapılara bağlıdır; öznenin vazgeçmesi ile başkasını alıkoyması tanımda ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyden vazgeçip ona yönelmeyi bırakmak veya bir başkasını o şeyden uzak tutup alıkoymaktır. Sütten kesmeye benzer biçimde bir alışkanlığı ya da işi kestirmek bu ikinci yönün özel bir anlatımıdır.

facets.statement: Özne yöneldiği bir şeyden vazgeçer veya geri durur.
Bir kişi başkasını bir işten uzak tutar veya o işi ona bıraktırır.
Alıkoyma, birini bir işten sütten keser gibi kesme biçiminde anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, bir şeye yönelişi kesmektir; bu kesilme öznenin kendi vazgeçişi veya başka bir kişinin onu engellemesi biçiminde gerçekleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın dönüşlü ve ettirgen iki katılımcı düzenini kısa ve doğal biçimde birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kendi yönelişini kesme ile başkasının yönelişini kestirme ayrımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öznenin bir konuyu veya davranışı kendi isteğiyle bıraktığı yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öznenin yöneldiği şeyden geri durmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişiyi belirli bir işten uzak tuttuğu yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen katılımcı düzenini ve engellenen işi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, başkasını bir işten kesme ve sütten kesmeye benzer ettirgen alıkoyma kullanımını açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, geri çekilmenin yanında bir işi bir yana bırakma ve evde kalma gibi daha geniş uzak durma görünümlerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeye yönelişi kesme, ondan geri durma veya onu bırakma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, belirli yapılarda kendi vazgeçişiyle başkasını alıkoymayı eşler; komşu daha genel geri çekilme ve yüz çevirme alanına yayılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, kişinin kendi isteğiyle vazgeçmesini ve kişisel bir ettirgen alıkoymayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, giriş, çıkış veya eylem üzerinde engel, yasak, görevli ve yaptırım gibi kurumsal sınırlar da kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişinin belirli bir eylemi yapmasını önleme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yönelişin kesilmesine odaklanır; komşu ise fiziksel, hukuki veya kurumsal engel ve yasağı daha geniş bir çekirdek olarak taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel geri durma ile geniş engelleme alanları yayımlandı, daha dar tutma ve ayırma adayları bunlara göre yinelenen ya da uzak kaldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أعذب عن الشيء إذا تركه أو امتنع عنه، وأعذب غيره أو عذبه إذا منعه، والفطام عن أمر، وصيغة أعذبوا عن النساء في الذكر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس العذوبة في الماء، ولا العقوبة والإيجاع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أعذب عن الشيء إذا لها عنه وتركه (maqayis)؛ أعذب عن الشيء إذا امتنع عنه (jamhara;tahdhib)؛ أعذبته عن الأمر إذا منعته عنه (sihah)؛ عذبته تعذيبا كقولك فطمته عن هذا الأمر (ayn;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, bir varlık ile gökyüzü arasında hiçbir örtü bulunmamasını doğrudan bildirir. Aynı biçimlerin yememe-içmeme dalında da bulunması bu mekânsal anlamı değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel çıplaklıktan daha dardır: belirleyici koşul, varlıkla gökyüzü arasındaki üst örtünün yokluğudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın durum bildiren biçimler ile geceyi gökyüzüne açık geçirme yapısı aynı mekânsal çekirdek altında, yapı sınırları korunarak verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın kendisiyle gökyüzü arasında hiçbir dam, örtü veya siper bulunmadan açıkta kalmasıdır.

facets.statement: Varlık ile gökyüzü arasında onu örten hiçbir engel bulunmaz.
Bu durum geceyi gökyüzüne açık ve örtüsüz geçirme örneğiyle anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, gökyüzüyle kişi veya nesne arasında örtü bulunmayan açıkta kalma durumunda birleşir ve bunu geceleme örneğiyle gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Üstünde hiçbir örtü olmadan doğrudan gökyüzüne açık kalan kişi veya nesne için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gökyüzü yönünü ve aradaki örtünün bütünüyle yokluğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin geceyi üstünde dam veya örtü bulunmadan geçirdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geceleme olayını ve gökyüzüne açık kalmayı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak özellikle üst örtünün yokluğunu ve gökyüzüne doğrudan açık olmayı şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu giysisizliği, genel örtüsüzlüğü, açık araziyi ve eyersiz hayvanı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir varlığı örten veya gizleyen bir katmanın bulunmaması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dikey olarak gökyüzüne açık kalma durumudur; komşu beden, yer ve hayvan üzerinde çok daha genel bir örtüsüzlük alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, yerdeki genişlikten bağımsız olarak bir varlığın üstünde örtü bulunmamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, geniş ve açık bir alanı ve kişinin o alana çıkmasını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Açık gökyüzü altında bulunma sahnesinde iki dal birlikte gerçekleşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kişinin veya nesnenin örtüsüz durumudur; komşu ise bulunulan yerin geniş ve açık oluşunu merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel örtüsüzlük ile açık alan adayları sınırı en iyi gösterdi, öteki adaylar belirli yüzeyler, görünürlük veya uzak mekân ilişkileridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العذوب أو العاذب الذي لا ستر بينه وبين السماء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد الامتناع عن الطعام والشراب إلا حيث احتملته الشواهد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العذوب الذي ليس بينه وبين السماء ستر وكذلك العاذب (maqayis;tahdhib)؛ فبات عذوبا للسماء كأنه سهيل (maqayis;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade ağır acı verme ve cezalandırma çekirdeğini doğrular. Bunun dayaktan türediği ve sonra her ağır sıkıntıya aktarıldığı açıklaması ortak zorunlu anlam değil, bildirilen bir köken ve genişleme görüşüdür; dal ancak bu kayıtla kabul edilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek ağır acı çektirme veya cezadır; her güçlük kendiliğinden bu dala girmez ve bildirilen dayak kökeni tanımın şartı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ad, eylem ve yok etmeye yönelik ceza yapısını ayırır; yapıya bağlı özel ceza bütün dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Birine ağır acı çektirme veya onu ağır biçimde cezalandırmadır. Dayak kökeni ve anlamın her türlü ağır sıkıntıya yayılması, çekirdeğin parçası değil aktarılan bir açıklamadır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ağır acı verilir veya ağır bir ceza uygulanır.
Belirli bir yapı, bütünüyle yok etmeye yönelik cezayı anlatır.
Bildirilen bir görüş anlamı dayaktan başlatır ve sonra her ağır sıkıntıya genişletir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek ağır acı verme ve cezalandırmadır; dayak kökeni ile her ağır sıkıntıya yayılma ise zorunlu anlamdan ayrı, aktarılan bir açıklamadır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem uygulanan ağır cezayı hem de birine şiddetli acı verme eylemini karşılayan çekirdek ifadedir.

error_profile.preserves: Ağır acı verme ile ceza uygulama bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eyleyenin başka bir kişiye şiddetli acı verdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleyeni, etkileneni ve ağır acının verilmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cezanın hedefi bütünüyle ortadan kaldırmak olduğunda kullanılan özel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Cezalandırmayı ve yok etmeye yönelik özel sonucu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ona ağır acı çektirdi veya ceza verdi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, acı vermenin yanında ağır ceza uygulamayı ve cezayı ad olarak da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, bir şeyin veya kişinin acı verici olduğunu nitelemeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: acı verme veya acı verici olma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da başka bir kişide acı meydana getirme alanında doğrudan örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak ağır acı ve ceza eksenindedir; komşu ise şiddet veya ceza şartı olmadan acı verme eylemini ve acı verici niteliği kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, acının bir başkasına uygulanmasını ve bunun ceza niteliği taşımasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, acıyı yaşayan kişinin bedensel veya ruhsal duyumunu merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Uygulanan ağır acı, etkilenen kişide acı duyumuna yol açar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak acının uygulanması ve cezalandırma yönündedir; komşu ise etkilenen kişinin acıyı hissetmesi durumudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, birine ağır acı veya ceza uygulanmasını çekirdek edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, sınanma niteliğindeki sıkıntıların yanında rahatlığı ve mal ya da çocuklarla sınanmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ağır sıkıntı veya ceza, iki dalın kesiştiği deneyim alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta acı verme ve ceza vardır; komşuda belirleyici unsur iyi veya kötü bir durumun sınama işlevi görmesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; acı verme, acı duyma ve sınanma adayları temel sınırları gösterdi, diğerleri belirli ceza türleri veya daha uzak şiddet sahneleridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العذاب والعقوبة والإيجاع الشديد، والتعذيب، وما يذكره المصدر من أصل الضرب ثم استعارة كل شدة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الماء العذب ولا طرف السوط المسمى عذبة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العذاب يقال منه عذب تعذيبا وناس يقولون أصل العذاب الضرب ثم استعير ذلك في كل شدة (maqayis)؛ عذبت الرجل وغيره تعذيبا والاسم العذاب (jamhara)؛ العذاب العقوبة وقد عذبته تعذيبا (sihah)؛ العذاب هو الإيجاع الشديد (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade kamçı ve dil ucu gibi uçları; mızrağa bağlanan bez, teraziyi kaldıran ip, ayakkabı bağı ucu ve dal gibi uzanan ya da sarkan parçaları birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu ortak biçimsel alanı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir şeyin ince ucu veya ona bağlı sarkan parçadır; su kirliliği, ceza ve hayvanın ayakları bu kapsama girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam çoğunlukla belirtilen nesneyle kurulan yapılara bağlıdır; uç, bağ, bez, ip ve dal gerçekleşmeleri tek bir yalın ada indirgenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin ince veya dışa uzanan ucu ya da ona bağlanıp sarkan ip, kayış, bez, deri veya dal parçasıdır. Belirli araç ve beden bölümlerinde parçanın yeri ve işlevi ayrıca belirlenir.

facets.statement: Kamçı veya dil gibi bir şeyin ince, dışa uzanan son bölümüdür.
Bir nesneye bağlanan veya ondan sarkan ip, kayış, bez ya da deri parçasıdır.
Ağaçta aynı biçimsel alan dışa uzanan dalı karşılar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar uçta bulunan veya bir şeye bağlanıp sarkan ince parçaları ortaklaştırır; kamçı, dil, mızrak, terazi, ağaç ve ayakkabı bağı bunun belirli gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: ince uç veya sarkan bağlı parça
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem doğal uçlarını hem de bir araca bağlanan ip, kayış, bez veya deri parçalarını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Uç konumunu, inceliği ve bağlı parçanın sarkma niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kamçının son bölümü ya da ona takılmış sarkan bağ anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kamçıya ait uç ve sarkan bağ seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayakkabı bağı, eyer veya başka bir kayışın serbestçe sarkan ucunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kayışa bağlı olmayı, uç konumunu ve sarkmayı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, uçların yanında mızrağa bağlanan bez, terazi ipi, dal ve sarkan kayış gibi bağlı parçaları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, uçtaki belirgin düğüm veya çıkıntıyı özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kamçı ucu ve ona benzetilen dil ucu iki dalın doğrudan ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu uç ve çıkıntı çevresinde kalır; odak bu alanı aşarak çeşitli nesnelere bağlı veya onlardan sarkan ince parçaları da adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, araçların işlevli uçlarını ve terazi ipi ya da mızrak bezi gibi özel bağlı parçaları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, saç örgüsünü ve bir şeyin en üst bölümünü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: örgü, üst bölüm veya sarkan bağ
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ayakkabı, kılıç veya eyerden sarkan bağ ve uzantılar iki dalda kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak uç ve bağlı ince parça düzenine dayanır; komşu saç örgüsü, en üst bölüm ve sarkan eklenti arasında daha geniş bir biçim alanı kurar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kamçı ve dil ucunu paylaşan aday ile sarkan bağ adayının ayrımı yayımlandı, diğerleri yalnız biçimsel benzerlik veya uzak parça ilişkisi gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه طرف السوط واللسان، والخرقة أو السير المشدود، والخيط، والغصن، وأطراف السيور والشراك، وما كان من علاقة أو ذوابة متدلية.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس العذاب ولا العذوبة في الماء، ولا القوائم المسماة عذوبات الناقة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: عذبة السوط طرفه (maqayis;tahdhib)؛ عذبة الرمح الخرقة التي تشد على رأسه (jamhara)؛ عذبة اللسان طرفه (jamhara;sihah;tahdhib)؛ عذبة الميزان الخيط الذي يرفع به (sihah;tahdhib)؛ عذبة الشجر غصنه (sihah;tahdhib)؛ عذبة شراك النعل المرسلة من الشراك (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal packet düzeyinde inceleme statüsünde tutulmuş sınır-riskli malzemeyi taşır. Kanıt, tek bir yalın kök imgesinden çok biçime veya özel kullanıma bağlı dağınık adlandırmaları gösterdiği için dal yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan sınırlı bir adlandırma kümesi olarak okunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dalın öğeleri genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, birbirinin yerine geçebilen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtta verilen biçim veya bağlam sınırı içinde tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanım kümesi sudaki çer çöpü veya havuz yüzeyindeki yosunsu tabakayı ve bunların temizlenmesini anlatır. Ayrı bir kullanım ise bir su başının çevresinde otlak ve ot bulunmadığını bildirir.

facets.statement: Suyun içinde çer çöp bulunur veya havuzun yüzeyini yosunsu bir tabaka kaplar.
Havuzdaki çer çöpü çıkarmak ya da yüzey tabakasını kırıp suyu görünür kılmak anlatılır.
Ayrı bir yapı, su başının çevresinde otlak veya ot bulunmamasını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: İnceleme statüsündeki kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok biçime veya özel bağlama bağlı sınırlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki dağınık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın inceleme statüsündeki sınırlı adlandırma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek tek kullanımların özel göndergelerini kavram karşılığının içine ayrı ayrı taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suda bulunan küçük yabancı maddeler veya bunların çokluğu anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun içindeki küçük yabancı maddeyi ve çokluk olasılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun kendisini değil, çevresinde hayvanların otlayacağı bitki bulunmamasını anlatan ayrı yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Su başını ve çevresindeki otlak yokluğunu birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sudaki çer çöp veya yüzey tabakası

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dal yalnız sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma malzemesini tuttuğu için yayımlanacak güvenilir komşu ayrımı seçilmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العذبة بمعنى القذاة في الماء، وكثرة القذى، وإزالة ما في الحوض من القذى أو عرمضه، مع شاهد تهذيب عن ماء لا رعي فيه ولا كلأ.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الماء العذب الطيب؛ بل مادة غير مرغوبة أو محيطة بالماء.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العذبة القذاة وماء ذو عذب أي كثير القذى (sihah)؛ أعذب حوضك أي انزع ما فيه من القذى (sihah)؛ اضرب عذبة الحوض حتى يظهر الماء أي اضرب عرمضه (tahdhib)؛ ماء ما به عذبة أي لا رعي فيه ولا كلأ (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade tek ve açık biçimde iyi, cömert ve değerli huylara sahip kişiyi niteler. Geçici çerçeve bu ahlaki kişilik niteliğini eksiksiz yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tat, su veya içim hoşluğu değil, kişinin iyi ve cömert karakterini bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız yalın kişi niteliğini verir; komşu erdem adları veya belirli davranış kalıpları bu dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İyi, cömert ve değerli huylara sahip kişi niteliğidir.

facets.statement: Kişi iyi, cömert ve değerli bir karakter taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek tanıklık kişiyi iyi ve cömert karakterli olarak niteleyen yalın bir sıfat anlamı verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin ahlaki karakterinin iyi, cömert ve değerli olduğunu bildiren genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye ait iyi ve cömert karakter niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin karakterini doğal bir ad öbeği içinde anlatmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İyi huyu, cömertliği ve kişi niteliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişiyi iyi ve cömert karakterli olması bakımından niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Verilen kanıt sınırlarında iki dal arasında kapsam, katılımcı veya koşul farkı görünmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak doğrudan kişinin iyi ve cömert huylu oluşunu bildiren bir niteliktir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, toplumsal olarak kabul edilen insanlık ve olgunluk idealini ve bu niteliği edinme çabasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İyi karakter ve toplumca değer verilen davranış niteliği iki dalda kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yalın bir iyi ve cömert huy sıfatıdır; komşu daha geniş bir kişilik ve toplumsal olgunluk idealini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tam eşleşen iyi karakter dalı ile daha geniş erdemli olgunluk alanı yayımlandı, diğerleri cömertliğin özel görünümleri veya uzak kişi tipleridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وصف العذبي بمعنى الكريم الأخلاق.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس العذب بمعنى الطيب من الماء إلا من جهة اللفظ المشترك في المادة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir anlam doğumdan sonra çocuğun ardından döl yatağından çıkan maddeyi bildirir. Ayrı bir anlam ise kadının döl yatağının kendisini adlandırır.

facets.statement: Doğumdan sonra çocuğun ardından döl yatağından bir madde çıkar.
Ayrı bir biçim kadının döl yatağını, yani doğacak çocuğun geliştiği organı adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın özel, yalıtık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek tek kullanımların özel göndergelerini kavram karşılığının içine ayrı ayrı taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çocuğun doğumunu izleyerek döl yatağından çıkan madde anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Maddenin doğumdan sonra ve döl yatağından çıkmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğacak çocuğun geliştiği kadın organının doğrudan adlandırıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadına ait anatomik organ referentini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: doğumdan sonra döl yatağından çıkan madde

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dal yalnız sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma malzemesini tuttuğu için yayımlanacak güvenilir komşu ayrımı seçilmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العذب الخارج على أثر الولد من الرحم، والعذابة بمعنى الرحم.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس العذاب ولا العذوبة ولا العذبة الطرفية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العذب ما يخرج على أثر الولد من الرحم (tahdhib)؛ العذابة رحم المرأة (tahdhib)

Sudaki madde dalı ile doğum dalında iç ayrıştırma gereklidir.
